records.name: input_ids
records.explanation: B independent sequences, each of T token ids in [0, vocab).

records.name: tok_emb
records.explanation: Each token id is replaced by a d_model-dimensional embedding vector.

records.name: pos_emb
records.explanation: Learned absolute position vectors broadcast over the batch.

records.name: residual_stream
records.explanation: Token + position embeddings entering the transformer stack.

records.name: layer0.attn.x
records.explanation: Residual stream entering attention.

records.name: layer0.attn.qkv
records.explanation: Packed Q,K,V projections.

records.name: layer0.attn.q
records.explanation: Queries split across H heads; head_dim = n_embd / n_head.

records.name: layer0.attn.k
records.explanation: Keys with the same layout as queries.

records.name: layer0.attn.v
records.explanation: Values with the same layout as queries.

records.name: layer0.attn.scores
records.explanation: Causal attention weights over key positions for each query position.

records.name: layer0.attn.out
records.explanation: Attention output projected back to d_model.

records.name: layer0.mlp.hidden
records.explanation: Position-wise FFN hidden layer, typically 4× d_model.

records.name: layer0.mlp.out
records.explanation: FFN output in residual-stream width.

records.name: layer1.attn.x
records.explanation: Residual stream entering attention.

records.name: layer1.attn.qkv
records.explanation: Packed Q,K,V projections.

records.name: layer1.attn.q
records.explanation: Queries split across H heads; head_dim = n_embd / n_head.

records.name: layer1.attn.k
records.explanation: Keys with the same layout as queries.

records.name: layer1.attn.v
records.explanation: Values with the same layout as queries.

records.name: layer1.attn.scores
records.explanation: Causal attention weights over key positions for each query position.

records.name: layer1.attn.out
records.explanation: Attention output projected back to d_model.

records.name: layer1.mlp.hidden
records.explanation: Position-wise FFN hidden layer, typically 4× d_model.

records.name: layer1.mlp.out
records.explanation: FFN output in residual-stream width.

records.name: final_hidden
records.explanation: LayerNorm'd residual stream before the language-model head.

records.name: logits
records.explanation: Unnormalised scores over the vocabulary at every token position.

records.name: targets
records.explanation: Next-token class indices in [0, vocab). Same layout as input_ids.

records.name: loss
records.explanation: Scalar mean loss; a 0-d tensor, not a 1-vector.
